name: Past Sin
overview: Scripture reveals that past sins are fully covered through genuine repentance and faith in Christ. Jesus calls sinners to repentance, emphasizing mercy over ritual sacrifice, highlighting God's desire to forgive those who turn to Him (Matthew 9:13). Salvation comes through heartfelt belief and confession, which leads to righteousness (Romans 10:10). Believers are united with Christ in His death and resurrection, living a new life empowered by faith in the Son of God who gave Himself for them (Galatians 2:20). This demonstrates that past sin is not a barrier to the new life found in Christ.
